typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BUS_FILE as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	DateTime as string (),
	Email_CC as string (),
	Email_From as string (),
	Email_To as string (),
	Excel_Name_final as string (),
	Excel_Path as string (),
	Filename as string (),
	Instance_Name as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string (),
	SMTP_Connection as string (),
	Table_data_Summary as string (),
	V_REC_EXISTS as integer ()
}

source(output(
		GRGR_ID as string,
		BLEI_CK as integer,
		BLIV_ID as string,
		BLBL_DUE_DT as timestamp,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM as timestamp,
		GRGR_NAME as string,
		BGBG_ID as string,
		BGBG_NAME as string,
		FACETS_TOTAL_MEM_COUNT as integer,
		CURRENT_ACTIVE_MEM_COUNT as integer,
		FACETS_TOTAL_AMT as integer,
		TOTAL_MEM_COUNT_TO_PSD as integer,
		TOTAL_AMT_TO_PSD as integer,
		PSD_SENT_DTM as timestamp,
		SENT_TO_PSD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT BLEI_CK  ,BLIV_ID    ,BLBL_DUE_DT     ,BLIV_CREATE_DTM               ,GRGR_ID                  ,GRGR_NAME                ,BGBG_ID                  ,BGBG_NAME                ,FACETS_TOTAL_MEM_COUNT   ,CURRENT_ACTIVE_MEM_COUNT ,FACETS_TOTAL_AMT  ,TOTAL_MEM_COUNT_TO_PSD        ,TOTAL_AMT_TO_PSD       ,PSD_SENT_DTM             ,SENT_TO_PSD     FROM         AGP.BFI_GRS_INVOICE_DAILY WHERE RPT_GENERATED = \'I\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of PSD_SENT_DTM} = toString(PSD_SENT_DTM),
		{Copy of CURRENT_ACTIVE_MEM_COUNT} = toString(CURRENT_ACTIVE_MEM_COUNT),
		{Copy of SENT_TO_PSD} = toString(SENT_TO_PSD),
		{Copy of BLIV_ID} = toString(BLIV_ID),
		{Copy of BLBL_DUE_DT} = toString(BLBL_DUE_DT),
		{Copy of BGBG_NAME} = toString(BGBG_NAME),
		{Copy of TOTAL_MEM_COUNT_TO_PSD} = toString(TOTAL_MEM_COUNT_TO_PSD),
		{Copy of FACETS_TOTAL_MEM_COUNT} = toString(FACETS_TOTAL_MEM_COUNT),
		{Copy of TOTAL_AMT_TO_PSD} = toString(TOTAL_AMT_TO_PSD),
		{Copy of BGBG_ID} = toString(BGBG_ID),
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} = toString(BLIV_CREATE_DTM),
		{Copy of BLEI_CK} = toString(BLEI_CK),
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} = toString(GRGR_ID),
		{Copy of FACETS_TOTAL_AMT} = toString(FACETS_TOTAL_AMT),
		{Copy of GRGR_NAME} = toString(GRGR_NAME)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of BLEI_CK} as string,
		{Copy of TOTAL_MEM_COUNT_TO_PSD} as string,
		{Copy of TOTAL_AMT_TO_PSD} as string,
		{Copy of BLIV_ID} as string,
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} as string,
		{Copy of BLBL_DUE_DT} as string,
		{Copy of BGBG_NAME} as string,
		{Copy of GRGR_NAME} as string,
		{Copy of PSD_SENT_DTM} as string,
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of FACETS_TOTAL_AMT} as string,
		{Copy of BGBG_ID} as string,
		{Copy of CURRENT_ACTIVE_MEM_COUNT} as string,
		{Copy of FACETS_TOTAL_MEM_COUNT} as string,
		{Copy of SENT_TO_PSD} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
